# Liquidity coverage ratio (`lcr` v1)

Basel III LCR: high-quality liquid assets against 30-day stressed net outflows.

**Group:** Liquidity · **Mnemonic:** `LCR` · **Identifiers:** `LCR-…` in `lcrId`

Open one with `LCR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: lcr
version: 1
description: "Basel III LCR: high-quality liquid assets against 30-day stressed net outflows."
match: { kind: lcr, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Liquidity · Liquidity coverage ratio, id: $.lcrId }
strip:
  - { label: Entity, bind: $.legalEntityName }
  - { label: LCR, bind: $.lcr, fmt: pct0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: HQLA, bind: $.hqla, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Net outflows (30d), bind: $.netOutflows, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Minimum, bind: $.minimum, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: Buffer over minimum, bind: $.buffer, fmt: compact, tone: sign }
  - { label: As of, bind: $.asOf, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: hqla
    kind: hbar
    title: HQLA after haircuts by level
    code: HQLA
    key: F2
    rows: $.hqlaByLevel
    label: level
    value: value
    fmt: compact
  - id: outflows
    kind: table
    title: Stressed outflows and inflows (30 days)
    key: F3
    rows: $.flows
    columns:
      - { label: Category, bind: "@.category" }
      - { label: Balance, bind: "@.balance", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Rate, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct0 }
      - { label: Flow, bind: "@.flow", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
  - id: trend
    kind: line
    title: "LCR, last 30 business days"
    area: right
    rows: $.trend
    x: date
    y: lcr
    fmt: pct0
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
